item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Left Edge Sneaker Stays Visible

turns.text: Make this square for my shop. The shoe's way over on the left, so don't just crop the middle. Keep the whole shoe; plain padding to match the background is fine if needed. No other edits.

item.tests: Tests subject-aware reframing of an off-centre product instead of a default centre crop that loses the subject.

answer_sheet.Subject and placement: Keep the entire sneaker at the far left of the original. Its position within the new square is your call.
answer_sheet.Handling a tight crop: Use plain padding matching the background if necessary to keep the whole shoe.
answer_sheet.Other edits and text: No other edits and no added text.

must_haves: The output includes the original left-side sneaker, not an empty crop of the middle of the source.
The complete sneaker remains visible, including toe, heel and sole.
The sneaker's proportions, colour and details match the source.
Any added padding blends with the source background, with no text or decorative additions.

turns.text: Could you adjust this pic for me, keeping the whole shoe visible rather than cutting any of it off? I'm getting it ready for my shop and I'm a little worried about accidentally losing part of the shoe when the framing changes. What I need is a square image for the shop, and the shoe is way over on the left in the original, so please don't just crop the middle. Plain padding that matches the background is fine if you need it to keep the entire shoe. Please make no other edits.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the square version because your connected Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

To avoid losing any of the shoe, use **canvas padding, not cropping**: keep the full original photo at its current proportions, make the canvas square, and fill the added space above and below with matching gray. This preserves the entire shoe without other edits.

style.prompt: Make this photograph square ONLY by adding plain padding above and below the original rectangular image. Match padding to the neutral gray background of the photo. Retain the ENTIRE original image within the square, at its original proportions, including the complete shoe on the left, toe, heel, sole, laces, shadow and all existing background content. Do not crop or zoom, especially not a center crop. Do not redraw, retouch, clean up, recolor, move or otherwise change the shoe or any original image content. Only extend the canvas with plain matching padding to obtain a 1:1 square.
